offerings.name: Reader API for web search and SERP (s.jina.ai)
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on the token usage. Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens. Token packages: Toy Experiment 10 Million tokens Free; Prototype Development 1 Billion tokens $50 (0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment 11 Billion tokens $500 (0.045 / 1M tokens).
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens! / Toy Experiment: 10 Million Tokens valid for Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC). Free
offerings.output_type: 搜索结果结构化输出（JSON：URL、title、content、timestamp），clean LLM-friendly text；Search mode 返回五条结果
offerings.note: Prepends https://s.jina.ai/?q= to the query; returns the top five results with their URLs and contents. Rate limit 100 RPM (free/paid key), 1000 RPM premium; average latency 2.5s; GET/POST.
